1879064288.name: Retaliation
1879064288.desc: A retaliation after parrying an attack.\n\n <rgb=#00FFDD>Requires a parry response.</rgb>

1879095392.name: Wight's Rot (Ranged)
1879095392.desc: This warband skill does direct ranged damage to your target, then transfers power to you from your target and can contribute to warband manoeuvres.

1879110112.name: Improved Shield-blow
1879110112.desc: You strike your opponent with your shield. This skill generates additional threat.

1879110240.name: Improved Cry of the Chorus (Melody)
1879110240.desc: This skill provides you with three healing ballad bonus effects allowing access to Anthems and Codas.  It also breaks any silence effects on you and provides you with a short term immunity to silence.

1879111264.name: Rend
1879111264.desc: Makes a full AoE attack, which causes medium damage-over-time.

1879115488.name: Two Cut
1879115488.desc: Fast attacks against the foes of darkness.

1879132256.name: Careful Step
1879132256.desc: Move in stealth briefly.\n\nFacilitates ability to Ambush.

1879136736.name: Purge
1879136736.desc: Your derision cows even the weakest of Angmar's whelps into ignoring some harmful effects.

1879139040.name: Rend Flesh
1879139040.desc:
Your attack tears into your opponent's flesh, weakening their defences.

   <rgb=#00FFDD>Requires a Critical Response

Increased damage when attacking from behind</rgb>

1879198304.name: Friend of Small Fowl (Mottled-raven)
1879198304.desc: Summons a raven companion.\n\nThe raven specializes in buffing and debuffing.

1879228128.name: Prepare Spear
1879228128.desc: A motion that readies the Warden's Spear for attack.

1879244000.name: Discipline: Red Dawn
1879244000.desc:
<rgb=#66fff>Mounted Discipline</rgb>

Mounted Disciplines are used to alter the attitude and tactics used by your War-steed in Mounted Combat

<rgb=#66ffff>Red Dawn</rgb>

The Red Dawn discipline allows the Captain to draw upon the prowess that made him a leader of the Free People, enhancing the relentless and tenacious nature of true leaders.

1879244256.name: Jollification
1879244256.desc: The Burglar takes great joy in wreaking havoc amongst their enemies.\n\n<rgb=#ff6600>This skill is enhanced by Trick: Stratagem.</rgb>

1879252320.name: Sword Sweep
1879252320.desc: This powerful sword swing damages enemies in front of Boromir, Gondor's favourite son.

1879291104.name: Challenge
1879291104.desc: Draws enemy threat away from your allies.

1879302624.name: Call to Arms: Herald of Victory (Squire)
1879302624.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Victory into battle. This banner reduces power costs of those around it.

1879330272.name: Red Eagle
1879330272.desc: Summons an eagle to keep you company.

1879358816.name: Beer-loving Badgers Kite
1879358816.desc: Brings out a kite depicting three Beer-loving Badgers for you to fly!

1879408992.name: Expose (Bear, Dual)
1879408992.desc: Seeing a weakness in the enemy's defences, you exploit it, increasing your target's vulnerability to damage.\n\nMakes targets more vulnerable to Melee damage in Bear form.

1879412832.name: Blood Craban
1879412832.desc: Summons a blood craban to watch over you.

1879416032.name: The ground beneath my feet dances...

1879417824.name: Steed of Bright Company
1879417824.desc: A steed that draws the eye and a smile wherever it goes.

1879420512.name: Fulgurant Strike
1879420512.desc:
This strike catches the enemy unawares, leaving them breathless and interrupting complex skills and manoeuvres.

Interrupts

This skill cannot be blocked, parried, or evaded.
This skill cannot miss.
This skill can be deflected.

1879468384.name: Nature's Mend - Tier 2
1879468384.desc: You call on nature to increase the Morale of your target's fellowship.

1879486048.name: Call to Arms: Herald of Hope (Umbari Guardswoman)
1879486048.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Hope into battle. This banner increases the mitigations of those around it.

1879497696.name: Major Pet Command
1879497696.desc: Command your pet to execute a major skill on themselves or their target.

1879506656.name: Wisp of Flame
1879506656.desc: Adherents of Balefire have learned to harness power as their enemy burns.<rgb=#00ffff>\n\nCan be prepared as a Sorcerous Study.</rgb>

1879527392.name: Essence of the Vanquished
1879527392.desc: Use the Essence of the Vanquished to cleanse your Curse of the Gaurhoth.
